concepts.name: Customer
concepts.description: A residential, business, or industrial customer purchasing energy.

concepts.name: Account
concepts.description: A billing relationship between the company and a customer.

concepts.name: Contract
concepts.description: A signed agreement on tariff, term, and product between customer and supplier.

concepts.name: Premise
concepts.description: A physical location at which energy is supplied (the site identifier).

concepts.name: Customer Interaction
concepts.description: A discrete contact with a customer across any channel.

concepts.name: Asset
concepts.description: A managed physical asset (e.g. transformer, generator, vehicle).

concepts.name: Asset Type
concepts.description: A class of asset with shared characteristics (taxonomy reference data).

concepts.name: Asset Condition
concepts.description: A point-in-time assessment of an asset's condition.

concepts.name: Maintenance Work Order
concepts.description: A request to perform maintenance on an asset.

concepts.name: Generation Unit
concepts.description: An individually-dispatchable generating unit.

concepts.name: Production Output
concepts.description: Energy produced by a unit over a reporting interval.

concepts.name: Fuel Consumption
concepts.description: Fuel consumed by a generating unit over a reporting interval.

concepts.name: Generation Outage
concepts.description: A planned or unplanned outage of a generation unit.

concepts.name: Network Node
concepts.description: A node in the transmission or distribution network topology.

concepts.name: Connection Point
concepts.description: Point at which a customer, generator or interconnector connects to the network.

concepts.name: Network Capacity
concepts.description: Available capacity for a network element or path.

concepts.name: Power Flow
concepts.description: Measured or estimated power flow across a network element.

concepts.name: Network Outage
concepts.description: A planned or unplanned outage of a network element.

concepts.name: Market Price
concepts.description: A published or transacted price for an energy product on a market.

concepts.name: Trade
concepts.description: An individual trade between counterparties.

concepts.name: Position
concepts.description: Net exposure across products and tenors, derived from trades.

concepts.name: Counterparty
concepts.description: A market counterparty to a trade or contract.

concepts.name: Settlement
concepts.description: Financial and physical settlement of a trade or market position.

concepts.name: Meter
concepts.description: A device measuring consumption or production at a metering point.

concepts.name: Metering Point
concepts.description: Logical point at which metered consumption or production is measured (MPxN).

concepts.name: Meter Reading
concepts.description: A reading captured from a meter, validated or estimated.

concepts.name: Consumption
concepts.description: Energy consumed at a metering point over an interval, derived from readings.

concepts.name: Tariff
concepts.description: A published or contracted price plan for a retail energy product.

concepts.name: Bill
concepts.description: An invoice issued to a customer for an account period.

concepts.name: Payment
concepts.description: A payment received from a customer against a bill or balance.

concepts.name: Arrears
concepts.description: Outstanding overdue balance against an account.

concepts.name: Licence
concepts.description: A regulatory licence held by the business.

concepts.name: Regulatory Obligation
concepts.description: A specific obligation arising from regulation or licence.

concepts.name: Compliance Report
concepts.description: A periodic report submitted to a regulator.

concepts.name: Emission
concepts.description: A measured or estimated greenhouse-gas emission.

concepts.name: Renewable Source
concepts.description: A renewable generation source (e.g. wind farm, solar plant).

concepts.name: Carbon Credit
concepts.description: A carbon-emissions credit or allowance.

concepts.name: Employee
concepts.description: A person employed by the business.

concepts.name: Field Crew
concepts.description: A team carrying out field operations such as installation or maintenance.

concepts.name: Supplier
concepts.description: A supplier of goods or services to the business.

concepts.name: Invoice Payable
concepts.description: An invoice owed by the business to a supplier.

concepts.name: Cost Centre
concepts.description: A cost centre in the financial reporting structure.
